The unmodified `bert-base-chinese_s2t_dict.txt` mapping is from g2pW:
https://github.com/GitYCC/g2pW/blob/master/g2pw/bert-base-chinese_s2t_dict.txt

Retrieved on 2026-09-10. It is distributed under the Apache License 2.0;

Kkindle embeds this mapping so already-installed g2pW models can process
simplified Chinese without downloading the model again.
